name: MedTech Solutions Compression Recovery Suit
description:
A full-body compression garment with graduated pressure zones that promote blood circulation, reduce inflammation, and accelerate muscle recovery. Embedded sensors monitor the wearer's physiological state and adjust compression in real time through micro-pump bladders along each limb.

Used by athletes, augmentation recovery patients, and laborers whose bodies take daily punishment they can't afford to heal from slowly. The suit is worn under work clothes and runs continuously, turning downtime into recovery time.
functionality: Dynamic compression therapy, real-time recovery monitoring, inflammation reduction
what_it_says: Your body is breaking down and you're patching it faster than it can fall apart.
story_hooks: A laborer's Compression Recovery Suit data log shows muscle damage patterns inconsistent with their stated occupation — they're not lifting crates, they're fighting.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, second-skin silhouette that clings to the body like a high-tech wetsuit. The garment presents a unified aesthetic of medical functionality meets athletic wear—smooth, purposeful, with subtle geometric segmentation across major muscle groups. When worn, the wearer appears almost augmented, their natural physiology enhanced by visible pressure architecture.
physical_description.fit: Compression-fitted, anatomically contoured to follow the body's natural lines. Snug through the torso, shoulders, and limbs without restriction of movement. Designed to be worn as a base layer beneath loose work clothes, creating an invisible performance shell.
physical_description.primary_material: Medical-grade synthetic elastomer blend with embedded bio-responsive microfiber—a proprietary smart-fabric that conducts electrical signals to micro-pump actuators. The base is breathable moisture-wicking poly-blend with antimicrobial treatment.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and slightly tacky to the skin with subtle ribbed pressure channels running longitudinally along arms and legs. The surface has a faint sheen suggesting synthetic sophistication. Embedded micro-pump lines create barely perceptible ridges at key vascular points.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal-black primary with accent strips in bioluminescent cyan and medical white at pressure zones (wrists, ankles, sternum, lower back). Faint grid patterns visible under certain light angles indicate sensor arrays.
physical_description.closures: Full-body zipper running from left ankle, up the inside leg, across the torso and up to the right shoulder. Magnetic snap seals at wrists and ankles for micro-pump connection points. Friction-fit collar with velcro closure at the neck for sensor contact optimization.
distinctive_features: Embedded pressure-gradient visualization—darker at high-compression zones, lighter at lower-compression areas
Visible micro-pump bladder lines along forearms, calves, and lower back—faint tubing visible beneath translucent material panels
Sensor array indicators (small metallic contacts) at pulse points: neck, wrists, inner elbows, ankles
MedTech Solutions logo embroidered in reflective thread at left chest
Small digital readout port (magnetic coupling) at upper right shoulder for wireless data sync
Graduated compression zones marked by subtle color gradation and material texture shifts
Reinforced panels at high-stress areas (shoulders, glutes, hamstrings, calves) with visible stitching
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 boundary. Expensive enough to signal investment in one's body (Tier 2 corpo athletes, augmentation patients), but increasingly common among Tier 3 laborers and industrial workers who pool resources to afford one. A status item disguised as medical necessity.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by augmentation recovery patients during the painful integration period post-surgery. Construction workers, dock laborers, and combat-sport athletes use these to convert sleep into productive recovery. The suit marks the wearer as someone whose body is both an asset and a liability—someone who pushes themselves to the edge professionally.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine and well-maintained when new (expensive to replace). With use, develops slight discoloration at pressure points from sweat and skin oils. Seams remain tight; the material is engineered for durability. Faint creasing at flex points. After months of use, may show slight dulling of the bioluminescent accents where sensors have been repeatedly activated.
